pr_title: Sync tado zones after updating climate preset
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
As discussed in #79332, when changing the preset mode for a climate device in home assistant the tado integration publishes the update over the tado API but does not a trigger state sync. Thereby the sensor `sensor.<title>_tado_mode` and the attribute `climate.<title>.preset_mode` stay in the previous state until the state is synced due to polling (after several minutes in worst case). The proposed code change triggers this sync (for all zones) after changing the preset mode.

issue_context.title: Tado presence mode does not sync
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The sensor created for the tado room called "tado mode" is always 'home' in Home Assistant. I can change the preset/mode with a service call in both directions ('home' / 'away'), but Home Assistant never catches this change. Changing the preset to away using the thermostat card, does not stick in the dashboard. The tado app however shows the change.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.10.0b1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Tado

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tado/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Already reported before in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/69305.
comments:
Hey there @michaelarnauts, @north3221, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`tado`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L1121) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

---

[tado documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tado)
[tado source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/tado)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

I'm running version 2022.09 using Docker and can not confirm this issue. When I update the home/away state in the tado app it flawlessly syncs the state for all thermostats in HA in a few seconds. Did you experience this behaviour in older versions?

So I am using Home Assistant 2022.9.7 and I can reproduce the problem. I have also already reinstalled the integration once, the problem remains the same. It only fetches the status once when adding but it does not update.
What type of installation are you running?

Hmm, that's exactly my setup. You could enable [debug logging](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/logger/) for the tado integration and check if you can find any hints about it. Do you have any other problems with the integration?
The only problems I could find are that the Home/Away status cannot be set or sync'd. Report again when I have enabled logging.
@fpfuetsch Do you have an active subscription for tado?
If I set the status in HA for a device to "Away", the status is also displayed in Tado, but HA remains at "Home".

No, I don't have a tado subscription, since HA does the job for free.

I just noticed I misunderstood the initial problem statement. I thought the problem is that HA does not reflect the changes made in the tado app but it's actually the other way around. 🤦 

So I can also confirm the mentioned problem, that a service call like this:

```yml
service: climate.set_preset_mode
data:
  preset_mode: away
target:
  entity_id:
    - climate.<thermostat>
```

sets the geofencing state in the tado app to `away` but `sensor.<thermostat>_tado_mode` stays at state `home` as well as the attribute `climate.<thermostat>.preset_mode`

Okay, good to know. :) I don't have a subscription either, since I let HA do the function. I just wanted to make sure we are talking about the same scenario. In general, polling of the data seems to occur only every x minutes. In logging, I actually could not see any problem.

```
MIN_TIME_BETWEEN_UPDATES = timedelta(minutes=4)
SCAN_INTERVAL = timedelta(minutes=5)
```

>  In general, polling of the data seems to occur only every x minutes. 

That's it, it just takes some time (max ~5 min) to update the tado mode sensor 💡. Very unfortunate that the polling timedelta is that high, but it seems to be intended (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/46915). It is even that high that we thought the integration has a bug.

I just checked the behaviour again. Seems indeed like it does set in Tado but not reflect in HA. We can't rely on those preset sensors.

Just weird behaviour it bounces back when setting, how can a user verify it is set correctly? It should poll again when changing a value.

I don't experience the same when changing the temperature or operation mode (auto/heat/off) but did not check how that is handled in code yet.

Also 5 minutes makes no sense if users use the open window sensors to turn off the heating (with HA so we don't pay those crazy subscription fees).
It's a real shame that Tado doesn't offer any webhooks or websockets...
they actually don't even offer the API, is more or less reverse engineered
Ah ok, should probably think again about returning to Homematic. :D
